name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.28-beta “Paris” (build 30) — Word add-in fixes.
• Fixes “Compile error in hidden module: LitArbiRibbon”: the Mac version of the Word add-in, installed by an early Windows build, is replaced with the Windows add-in (Word must be closed; LitArbi asks).
• Installing or repairing the add-in no longer fails with “the file is being used by another process”.
• Settings → Word Add-in → Check Word add-ins… shows which templates Word loads and repairs problems.
• Everything from build 26: full parity with macOS 0.9.28.
